united-nations.title: Flag of the United Nations
desc: - The United Nations flag (adopted 1947) features a white world map in azimuthal equidistant projection within olive branches on a light blue field

- **Construction:** a light blue field bearing the UN emblem in white at the centre — a polar azimuthal equidistant projection of the world map centred on the North Pole, surrounded by two olive branches
trivia:
- The United Nations flag represents the international organisation established in 1945
- The olive branches represent peace; the globe represents universality
- Adopted in 1945 as the symbol of international cooperation

european-union.title: Flag of Europe / European Union
desc:
- The European flag (adopted 1955 by Council of Europe, 1985 by the EU) features twelve gold stars in a circle on a blue field, symbolising unity and perfection
- **Construction:** a blue field (2:3 ratio) bearing a circle of twelve five-pointed gold stars centred
- The stars are upright (one point up) and evenly spaced like the hours on a clock face
- The circle diameter is one-third of the flag's hoist
- The twelve stars represent unity, not member states
trivia:
- The 12 stars represent perfection and completeness, not the number of member states
- The circle represents unity and solidarity
- Adopted in 1986 and represents European integration and cooperation

african-union.title: Flag of the African Union
desc: - The African Union flag features a green field with a gold outline of Africa surrounded by white stars and a green olive wreath border, adopted in 2010
- **Construction:** a dark green field with the AU emblem centred — a gold circle of 55 gold stars (representing member states) surrounding a gold map of Africa, with gold palm branches below
trivia:
- The African Union (founded 2002) represents 55 African member states
- Replaced the Organization of African Unity in 2002
- Promotes regional integration, peace, and economic cooperation across Africa

arab-league.title: Flag of the League of Arab States
desc:
- The Arab League flag features a green field with a gold crescent, chain link, Arabic script for the League's name, and a wreath of laurels
- **Construction:** a green field bearing the emblem of the Arab League in gold/white at the centre — a crescent enclosing a stylised name in Arabic, within a chain-link wreath
- Twenty-two links represent the member states
trivia:
- The Arab League flag represents the unified Arab nations
- The interlocking rings represent the unity and brotherhood of Arab states
- Established in 1945, the League coordinates policies across 22 member states

nato.title: Flag of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization
desc: - The NATO flag features a dark blue field with a white compass rose symbolising the direction of peace. Adopted in 1953
- **Construction:** a dark blue field bearing the NATO compass rose emblem in white at the centre — a four-pointed star within a circle, with lines extending from each point to the edge of the circle
trivia:
- NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) is a military and political alliance
- The flag represents the unity of 32 member states
- Established in 1949 during the Cold War

olympic.title: The Olympic Flag
desc:
- The Olympic flag (designed 1913 by Pierre de Coubertin) features five interlocking rings on white, representing the five participating continents
- **Construction:** a white field bearing five interlocking rings (the Olympic rings) centred — blue, yellow, black, green, and red (left to right, top then bottom)
- The rings interlock in a specific pattern
trivia:
- The Olympic flag features five interlocking rings representing continental unity
- The rings represent the five inhabited continents and their integration
- Adopted in 1913 and used during Olympic Games

red-cross.title: Emblems of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement
desc:
- The Red Cross (1863) and Red Crescent (1876) emblems are protected symbols of humanitarian neutrality. The crystal (2005) serves as a third emblem
- **Construction:** a white field bearing a red cross (the reverse of the Swiss flag)
- The cross arms are of equal length and width
- The Red Crescent variant uses a red crescent on white

countryData.name: Red Cross
countryData.officialName: International Committee of the Red Cross

trivia:
- The Red Cross (International Committee of the Red Cross) is a humanitarian organisation
- The flag represents neutrality, impartiality, and humanitarian protection
- Founded in 1863 to provide relief during conflicts

asean.title: Flag of ASEAN
desc: - The ASEAN flag features a blue field with a red circle containing a stylised rice plant motif, representing the ten member states of Southeast Asia
- **Construction:** a blue field with the ASEAN emblem centred — ten yellow rice stalks bound together in a red circle on a white background, all within a blue border
trivia:
- ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) represents 10 member states
- The flag represents regional cooperation and unity in Southeast Asia
- Established in 1967 to promote peace and economic cooperation

commonwealth.title: Flag of the Commonwealth of Nations
desc: - The Commonwealth of Nations flag features a gold globe surrounded by radiating spearhead shapes on a blue field, symbolising global cooperation
- **Construction:** a blue field bearing the Commonwealth symbol in gold at the centre — a globe surrounded by radiating lines forming the letter 'C'
trivia:
- The Commonwealth flag represents the Commonwealth of Nations
- Includes 56 member states, mostly former British colonies
- Emphasises cooperation and shared democratic values

oic.title: Flag of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation
desc: - The OIC flag features a green field with a red crescent and the Kaaba silhouette, representing the 57 member states of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation
- **Construction:** a green field bearing the OIC emblem in white — a crescent, a globe, and the text of the organisation name
trivia:
- The Organisation of Islamic Cooperation represents 57 member states
- The flag represents Islamic unity and cooperation
- Established in 1969 after the Al-Aqsa Mosque fire

gcc.title: Flag of the Gulf Cooperation Council
desc: - The GCC flag features a gold emblem on dark blue, representing the six Gulf states: Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, and Oman
- **Construction:** a field bearing the GCC emblem — a stylised map of the Arabian Peninsula surrounded by a hexagonal border representing the six member states

countryData.name: GCC
countryData.officialName: Cooperation Council for the Arab States of the Gulf

trivia:
- The Gulf Cooperation Council includes six Arab Gulf states
- The flag represents regional cooperation and economic integration
- Founded in 1981 during the Iran-Iraq War
